# Kaushik Kalathiya — WordPress Developer Portfolio

## About This Website
This is the professional portfolio website of Kaushik Kalathiya, a Senior WordPress Developer and Technical Support Specialist based in Surat, Gujarat, India.

## Professional Summary
Kaushik Kalathiya is a WordPress and WooCommerce developer with 8+ years of professional experience. He holds an MCA degree from Uka Tarsadia University and a BCA from Veer Narmad South Gujarat University. He is VIP Learn Certified, VTC Learn Advanced WordPress Debugging Certified, and IIT Bombay PHP & Java Certified.

His most recent role was Principal Software Engineer at Narola Infotech (2022–2025), where he led architectural decisions for client WordPress applications and mentored engineering teams.

## Core Services
- Custom WordPress Theme Development
- WooCommerce Store Development and Customization
- Custom Plugin Development
- ACF (Advanced Custom Fields) Pro Integration
- REST API and Webhook Integrations
- WordPress Performance Optimization & Core Web Vitals
- Technical Support and Debugging
- WordPress Site Migrations

## Technical Skills
WordPress, WooCommerce, PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, ACF Pro, REST APIs, Custom Post Types, Hooks & Filters, Git, Bootstrap
